REPAIR CHECKPOINT FOR ATTACK, NOT A CANDIDATE: ffb76be227c8800dbc18ffc4339f987176c5e633 on local branch codex/provider-parser-contract-v4-draft, child of held 48b495e. Working tree clean; do not review ancestry as final.

CACHE AUTHORITY: CachedParserProposal is now a final non-case witness privately minted only from an already-admitted successful ParserAttempt. It binds cache key, request checksum, proposal canonical identity, and source receipt in one derived checksum. External ParserCache implementations can retain/return values received through put but cannot construct or rewrite them. CacheHit now carries that witness. No-call ParserAttempt admission requires witness.admits(current input, current proposal), not the presence of a tag. fromCache also verifies the entry echoes the lookup key.

RELATIONAL COURT: a legitimate cached witness for request B is placed in a receipt for request/proposal A; ParserAttempt.proposed returns ProvenanceMissing. Mutating the admission line back to `!receipt.isCacheHit` kills exactly this court: CacheSuite 1 failed / 4 passed, mutation exit 1; restored afterward.

CARTESIAN RECORDS: AtlasToken and ParserDeterminismReport are final non-case/private-construction with public reads. ConstructionBoundarySuite compile-refuses direct constructor, apply, copy, exact companion fromProduct, and exact Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct for all three joined records. Exact-shaped public case-class controls prove constructor/apply/copy/Mirror; an already-compiled SurfaceUnit exact companion fromProduct control proves that separate door; a JVM reflection control proves the static fromProduct bytecode door and asserts the three sealed records omit it.

FOCUSED EVIDENCE: providerParser/clean providerParser/test = 68/68 (Contract 15, Cache 5, external ConstructionBoundary 11, Conforming 31, Determinism 2, Envelope 4), no warnings; providerParser/scalafmtCheckAll green; diff-check and production static scan clean. Please attack the witness relation and construction courts before I recut/supersede again.
